note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires retaining routes for all address families previously received in the GR Capability and marking them stale upon TCP termination. On first session drop (prev==nil), onSessionDownPlan populates staleFamilies from cap.Families and handleStructuredState dispatches retainPeerFamilies (retain-routes on-down families ...) followed by mark-stale before invoking completeDown. All 5 tagged units verified: TestRFC4724SessionDownRetainsAndMarksRoutesStale drives real RIB storage for ipv4-only (keeps IPv4 at stale-level 1, deletes unadvertised IPv6) and both-families (both at stale-level 1); TestRFC4724RetentionCoversEveryAdvertisedFamily verifies exact staleFamilies map and armed restartTimer; TestRFC4724SessionDownWithoutCapabilityRetainsNothing proves a stored received route is deleted on DOWN without GR capability; TestGRStateManagerRouteRetention and TestGRStateManagerNoGRCapability provide state-manager controls.
